insert into public.products (company_id, category_id, name, brand, viscosity, size_label,
                             description, image_url, retail_price, stock, is_active)
select (select id from public.companies where name = 'لم تتحدد الوكالة'),
       (select id from public.categories where name_ar = i.category),
       i.name, i.brand, i.viscosity, i.size_label, i.description, i.image_url, 1, 0, false
  from items i
 where not exists (select 1 from public.products p
                    where lower(p.brand) = lower(i.brand) and lower(p.name) = lower(i.name));

select count(*) as products_of_brand from public.products where lower(brand) = lower('Eurol');
